name: debt_by_batch
query:
SELECT
  bd.batch AS `batch`,
  bd.customer AS `customer`,
  COUNT(*) AS `debts`,
  SUM(bd.allocated_amount) AS `invoiced`,
  SUM(bd.paid_amount) AS `paid`,
  SUM(bd.returned_amount) AS `returned`,
  SUM(bd.offset_amount) AS `offset`,
  SUM(bd.outstanding_amount) AS `outstanding`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN bd.outstanding_amount > 0 AND bd.due_date < CURDATE()
           THEN bd.outstanding_amount ELSE 0 END) AS `overdue`
FROM `tabBatch Debt` bd
WHERE bd.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY bd.batch, bd.customer
ORDER BY `outstanding` DESC
